chunks: Saad narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'In the Friday prayer, there is no harm in reciting Surah Al-Ghafir (or other chapters) instead of Surah Al-Jumu'ah and Surah Al-Munafiqun if you are in a hurry.'

key_terms.مُسْتَعْجِلاً: In a hurry / shortening the prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on reciting other Surahs instead of Al-Jumu'ah and Al-Munafiqin in Friday prayer if shortening it?
ai.summary: This ruling from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the jurisprudential flexibility (rukhas) within Shia fiqh, allowing the omission of the highly recommended Surahs Al-Jumu'ah and Al-Munafiqah in favor of brevity when time is constrained. It reflects the principle that while these chapters are emphasized for their thematic relevance to Friday, the validity of the prayer is not contingent upon their recitation, prioritizing ease for the congregant. This underscores the Shia scholarly approach of balancing ritual excellence with practical accessibility in congregational worship.
